name: HR 5999

paper.title: A low optical depth region in the inner disk of the Herbig Ae star HR 5999

images.note: PIONIER H-band reconstructed image of the mas-scale inner disk rim (HD144668 panel; centrally peaked, significant asymmetry, likely rim-like); star subtracted (cyan star). Data from VLTI Large Program 190.C-0963, 2012 Dec 19 - 2013 Jun 06. Thermal NIR inner-rim emission - type per held VLTI record convention.

paper.title: A family portrait of disk inner rims around Herbig Ae/Be stars. Hunting for warps, rings, self shadowing, and misalignments in the inner astronomical units

images.note: Paper designation HR 5999 (=HD 144668=V856 Sco), a SEPARATE table row from MWC 863 (verified in target table). This is the first genuine Gemini-LIGHTS image of HR 5999 in the atlas: the two 'Gemini-LIGHTS' records currently in hr-5999.json are misfiled HD 145718 (Davies 2022) data - fix task flagged. Second J epoch 2017-04-06 in appendix set.

paper.title: Gemini-LIGHTS: Herbig Ae/Be and Massive T Tauri Protoplanetary Disks Imaged with Gemini Planet Imager

notes: Herbig Ae star in Lupus 3; VLTI/AMBER long-baseline interferometry (H,K) reconstructs a sub-AU near-IR image (MiRA algorithm) revealing a ring-like feature at ~0.65 AU tracing the silicate sublimation front (Benisty et al. 2011, arXiv:1106.4150).
